memories.text: function: reports difficulty climbing stairs due to joint pain and mild dyspnoea on exertion; manages cab driving with frequent breaks. cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (negative). falls: 0 falls in last 12 months, gait steady, TUG 10 seconds (normal). medicines: 5 regular (orlistat, methotrexate, folic acid, hydroxychloroquine, prednisolone). mood: denies low mood or anxiety. carers: spouse (husband). goals: "I want to drive longer shifts without knee pain."
